byline: L. W. King (translation) · The Avalon Project, Yale Law School (digital edition)
paragraph: 53. If any one be too lazy to keep his dam in proper condition, and does not so keep it; if then the dam break and all the fields be flooded, then shall he in whose dam the break occurred be sold for money, and the money shall replace the corn which he has caused to be ruined.
title: 水渠、堤坝与邻田损失
